namespace Space

variable (S : Space O F n)

def x0 : Ideal S.A := S.mB.map (S.inc : S.B →+* S.A)

def td (η : Ideal S.A) : Cardinal := Algebra.trdeg (S.B ⧸ η.comap (algebraMap S.B S.A)) (S.A ⧸ η)

namespace Loc

variable {S} {x : Ideal S.A} (L : S.Loc x)

def b : S.B →+* L.R := (L.ι : S.A →+* L.R).comp (S.inc : S.B →+* S.A)

def Pres : Prop :=
  ∃ (N N' : ℕ) (p : MvPowerSeries (Fin N) L.O' →ₐ[L.O'] L.R) (f : Fin N' → MvPowerSeries (Fin N) L.O'),
    N = N' + (n * F.d + 1) ∧ Function.Surjective p ∧ RingHom.ker p = Ideal.span (Set.range f)

def par (a g : ℕ) : Fin a ⊕ Fin g → ZMod 2 := Sum.elim (fun _ => 0) fun _ => 1

structure EPres where
  a : ℕ
  b : ℕ
  g : ℕ
  p : MvPowerSeries (Fin a ⊕ Fin g) L.O' →ₐ[L.O'] L.R
  Fe : Fin b → MvPowerSeries (Fin a ⊕ Fin g) L.O'
  Go : Fin g → MvPowerSeries (Fin a ⊕ Fin g) L.O'
  num : a = b + (n * F.d + 1)
  surj : Function.Surjective p
  ker : RingHom.ker p = Ideal.span (Set.range Fe ∪ Set.range Go)
  even : ∀ i, Fe i ∈ wtPart L.O' (par a g) 0
  odd : ∀ i, Go i ∈ wtPart L.O' (par a g) 1
  min : ∀ f ∈ RingHom.ker p, ∀ s, MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single s 1) f ∈ maximalIdeal L.O'
  ent : ∀ s i j, L.ρ.r s i j ∈ (wtPart L.O' (par a g) ((w n i - w n j : ℤ) : ZMod 2)).map p.toLinearMap
  base : ∀ y : S.B, L.b y ∈ (wtPart L.O' (par a g) 0).map p.toLinearMap
  ee : L.ρ.ee = Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => p (MvPowerSeries.X (.inr i)))

end Loc

end Space

def Chained {R : Type} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (D : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ P ∈ I.minimalPrimes, ((D + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P)) ∧
  ∀ P ∈ I.minimalPrimes, ∀ Q ∈ I.minimalPrimes, Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun P Q => P ∈ I.minimalPrimes ∧ Q ∈ I.minimalPrimes ∧ (D : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ (P ⊔ Q))) P Q

structure Space.Loc.Sharp {S : Space O F 3} {x : Ideal S.A} (L : S.Loc x) (I : Ideal L.R) : Prop where
  triv : ¬ S.u.ee ≤ x → I = ⊥
  off : ∀ P : Ideal L.R, P.IsPrime → ¬ L.ρ.ee ≤ P → I ≤ P
  chained : Chained I (3 * F.d + 1)
  dich : ∀ P ∈ I.minimalPrimes, L.ρ.TI P ∨ Thick L.ρ P

end UpperTheory.V.Fr

private theorem td_fin {B A D : Type} [CommRing B] [CommRing A] [CommRing D] [Algebra B A] [Algebra A D]

    (hη : p.comap (algebraMap A D) = η) :
    p.comap (algebraMap B D) = η.comap (algebraMap B A) ∧
    Algebra.trdeg (B ⧸ p.comap (algebraMap B D)) (D ⧸ p) = Algebra.trdeg (B ⧸ η.comap (algebraMap B A)) (A ⧸ η) := by
  subst hη
  rename_i iBD iT iI hp
  have hI : iBD = ((algebraMap A D).comp (algebraMap B A)).toAlgebra := by
    apply Algebra.algebra_ext
    intro r
    exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B A D r
  subst hI
  refine ⟨(Ideal.comap_comap _ _).symm, ?_⟩
  letI iBD' : Algebra B D := ((algebraMap A D).comp (algebraMap B A)).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra (B ⧸ Ideal.comap (algebraMap B A) (Ideal.comap (algebraMap A D) p)) (D ⧸ p) :=
    (Ideal.quotientAlgebra : Algebra (B ⧸ Ideal.comap (algebraMap B D) p) (D ⧸ p))
  haveI : IsScalarTower (B ⧸ Ideal.comap (algebraMap B A) (Ideal.comap (algebraMap A D) p))
      (A ⧸ Ideal.comap (algebraMap A D) p) (D ⧸ p) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    rfl
  haveI : FaithfulSMul (B ⧸ Ideal.comap (algebraMap B A) (Ideal.comap (algebraMap A D) p))
      (A ⧸ Ideal.comap (algebraMap A D) p) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr Ideal.algebraMap_quotient_injective
  haveI : FaithfulSMul (A ⧸ Ideal.comap (algebraMap A D) p) (D ⧸ p) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr Ideal.algebraMap_quotient_injective
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (A ⧸ Ideal.comap (algebraMap A D) p) (D ⧸ p) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isAlgebraic
  have key := trdeg_add_eq (B ⧸ Ideal.comap (algebraMap B A) (Ideal.comap (algebraMap A D) p))
    (A ⧸ Ideal.comap (algebraMap A D) p) (A := D ⧸ p)
  have h0 : Algebra.trdeg (A ⧸ Ideal.comap (algebraMap A D) p) (D ⧸ p) = 0 := trdeg_eq_zero
  rw [h0, add_zero] at key
  exact key.symm

import Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.AutomorphicVarieties.FrobeniusSmoothVectors.Integral

open IsLocalRing Matrix UpperTheory.V.Alg UpperTheory.V.U3 UpperTheory.V.Fr

private theorem alg_of_rel {R D : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [Algebra R D]
    (T : Subalgebra R D) {x c d : D} {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hc : c ∈ T) (hd : d ∈ T) (h0 : c ≠ 0)
    (h : x ^ p * c = d) : IsAlgebraic T x := by
  refine IsAlgebraic.of_pow hp ?_
  have hc' : (⟨c, hc⟩ : T) ≠ 0 := fun e => h0 (congrArg Subtype.val e)
  refine IsAlgebraic.of_smul (y := (⟨c, hc⟩ : T)) (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hc') ?_
  have : (⟨c, hc⟩ : T) • x ^ p = algebraMap T D ⟨d, hd⟩ := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]; exact h
  rw [this]
  exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap _

private theorem trdeg_le_one {R D ι : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [Algebra R D]
    [FaithfulSMul R D] (x : ι → D) (wt : ι → ℤ) (hgen : Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range x) = ⊤)
    (h0 : ∀ (i j : ι) (p q : ℕ), p * wt i + q * wt j = 0 → x i ^ p * x j ^ q ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R D))
    {a b : ι} (ha : 0 < wt a) (hb : wt b < 0) (ha0 : x a ≠ 0) (hb0 : x b ≠ 0) : Algebra.trdeg R D ≤ 1 := by
  set T : Subalgebra R D := Algebra.adjoin R {x a} with hT
  have haT : x a ∈ T := Algebra.subset_adjoin rfl
  have hR : ∀ {y}, y ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R D) → y ∈ T := by
    rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩; exact T.algebraMap_mem r
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le ha.le
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le (neg_nonneg.2 hb.le)
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by omega
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by omega
  have hq' : wt b = -q := by omega
  have key : ∀ i, IsAlgebraic T (x i) := by
    intro i
    rcases le_total (wt i) 0 with h | h
    · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le (neg_nonneg.2 h)
      have hm' : wt i = -m := by omega
      exact alg_of_rel T hp0 (pow_mem haT m) (hR (h0 i a p m (by rw [hm', hp]; ring))) (pow_ne_zero _ ha0) rfl
    · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le h
      have h1 := hR (h0 i b q m (by rw [hm, hq']; ring))
      have h2 := hR (h0 b a p q (by rw [hp, hq']; ring))
      refine alg_of_rel T (mul_pos hq0 hp0) (pow_mem h2 m) (mul_mem (pow_mem h1 p) (pow_mem haT (q * m)))
        (pow_ne_zero _ (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hb0) (pow_ne_zero _ ha0))) (by ring)
  have hall : Algebra.IsAlgebraic T D := ⟨fun y => by
    have hy : y ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range x) := hgen ▸ Algebra.mem_top
    induction hy using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem y hy => obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hy; exact key i
    | algebraMap r => exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap (⟨_, T.algebraMap_mem r⟩ : T)
    | add y z _ _ h1 h2 => exact h1.add h2
    | mul y z _ _ h1 h2 => exact h1.mul h2⟩
  simpa using Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trdeg_le_cardinalMk R ({x a} : Set D)

private theorem trdeg_quot_le_one {R A ι : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (η : Ideal A) (hη : η.IsPrime) (x : ι → A) (wt : ι → ℤ) (hgen : Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range x) = ⊤)
    (h0 : ∀ (i j : ι) (p q : ℕ), p * wt i + q * wt j = 0 → x i ^ p * x j ^ q ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R A))
    {a b : ι} (ha : 0 < wt a) (hb : wt b < 0) (ha0 : x a ∉ η) (hb0 : x b ∉ η) :
    Algebra.trdeg (R ⧸ η.comap (algebraMap R A)) (A ⧸ η) ≤ 1 := by
  refine trdeg_le_one (fun s => Ideal.Quotient.mk η (x s)) wt ?_ ?_ ha hb

    have : M = 0 := by
